audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[5].side read Zed and phases[6].side read Skill, while content win[5] and win[6] both read Aurelion Sol and the packet levelChart agreed with content.
audit.why: Zed owns levels 1-6 outright: Razor Shuriken reaches 900, Shadow Slash returns every 3-5s with a slow, and Death Mark is untargetable on the way in. From the first item the health and the black hole let Aurelion Sol hold ground, and from two items his permanent Stardust passes a Zed who needs kills to keep scaling.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side and phases[6].side moved to Aurelion Sol to match content and the packet, with phases[5].why rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and prose named 'Starsurge' and 'Voice of Light' (pre-rework Aurelion Sol abilities), promised a 'Q stun' and 'stun uptime' he does not have, called his ultimate 'global', and put Death Mark's one-shot threat in the Level 3 row.
audit.why: Breath of Light is a channelled beam with no stun; his only stun is Falling Star at 100-120s and 1250 range, which is not global; Death Mark is a level 6 ability, so whys[2] was describing the wrong stage.
audit.corrected: Fabricated names removed, the stun claims replaced with real ranges and cooldowns, and whys[2] re-pointed at Shadow Slash, which is what actually beats you at level 3.

audit.whatIsWrong: Death Mark's two decisive properties were never stated: it makes Zed untargetable on the dash, and it repeats a portion of his damage 3 seconds after the mark lands.
audit.why: Riot's text gives both. Together they define the counterplay — Falling Star spent into the dash hits nothing, and the 3-second delay is exactly what Zhonya's covers.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.carry, dosFull[1].d, spikes[1].text, whys[4] and content mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields described Zed roaming and repositioning off 'shadow resets'. Living Shadow does not reset.
audit.why: Living Shadow is 20/19/18/17/16 — it is a long cooldown, not a reset, and calling it one makes his roam timers look permanent when they are trackable.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real 16-20s cooldown and the real reason he roams (Death Mark being up).

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were other fields' strings under unrelated titles; dontsFull[0].d was a template that also called Zed 'they'; ahead, breakdown.carry and breakdown.feeding were name-swap templates.
audit.why: Copy-paste bleed, the pronoun defect, and the template sweep.
audit.corrected: All seven rewritten from Zed's kit at the same length.

audit.why: Real numbers: Death Mark 120/110/100 with a 3-second delayed proc, Living Shadow 20/19/18/17/16, Shadow Slash 5/4.5/4/3.5/3, Razor Shuriken a flat 6 at 900 range.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around those, with the Zhonya's-into-the-delay sequencing made explicit.

edits.before: Zed's Q-W harass chips you down from outside your effective trading range, and he can weave in and out with Shadow before your slow-windup Starsurge ever lands. Levels 1-5 you're mostly surviving — freezing, taking short trades only when his shadow is on cooldown, and avoiding overextending since a landed Death Mark at 6 can delete you outright.
edits.after: Razor Shuriken chips you down from 900, outside your effective trading range, and Living Shadow lets him throw from two places at once before your beam ever finishes. Levels 1-5 you are surviving — freezing, taking short trades only when Living Shadow is on cooldown, and never overextending, since a landed Death Mark at 6 deletes you outright.

edits.before: Level 6 is Zed's biggest spike: Death Mark plus a shadow swap gives him burst that can one-shot you if he catches you pushed up or out of position, and his shadow escape means your ult rarely punishes him back. Play centrally near allies, keep vision on his roam paths, and never let him get a free flank angle on you.
edits.after: Level 6 is Zed's biggest spike: Death Mark makes him untargetable on the way in, marks you, and repeats a portion of his damage 3 seconds later, so surviving those 3 seconds is the whole fight. Play centrally near allies, keep vision on his roam paths, and never give him a free flank angle.

edits.before: Once you hit your first item your range and stun uptime finally let you zone him and punish his cooldowns directly, and by full build your scaling AP damage and global ultimate outclass a Zed whose damage plateaus without kill snowball. Survive lane, group with your team, and let your late-game power carry.
edits.after: Once you hit your first item your 750 beam range finally lets you zone him and punish his cooldowns directly, and by full build your permanent Stardust and The Skies Descend outclass a Zed whose damage plateaus without kill snowball. Survive lane, group with your team, and let the late game carry.

edits.after: Zed wins by throwing Razor Shuriken from 900 and cashing Death Mark the moment you have no escape banked.

edits.before: - Zed Death Mark: matchup-defining — The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Astral Flight like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Death Mark is 120s at rank 1 and 100s at rank 3, and it repeats his damage 3s after the mark lands — Zhonya's covers exactly that window. - Living Shadow is 16-20s: with it down he has no second angle. - Shadow Slash is only 3-5s, so the slow is always there.

edits.before: Carry by scaling honestly — every stardust stack is permanent, and the 30-minute version of you wins fights your laning self cannot imagine.
edits.after: Carry by surviving three seconds: Death Mark only pays out on the delay, so a Zhonya's held for that tick turns his ultimate into nothing.

edits.before: If Zed opens the score, reset expectations and respect Death Mark doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with E executes and stay relevant through the stardust curve.
edits.after: If Zed opens the score his lethality comes online early and every Razor Shuriken hurts, so stop stepping up: clear from 750 with the black hole and buy Zhonya's components first.

edits.before: Ahead, compound it: shove with E executes, burn Zed on every W rotation, and group early — your beam turns small mid-game leads into unanswerable objective control.
edits.after: Ahead, keep him poor: Zed needs kills to matter, so shove with E executes, take every plate, and never hand him a solo angle where he can farm a lead.

edits.before: The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: A frozen wave keeps you at 750 from your own tower, which is further than the 625 his Death Mark can reach from.

edits.before: W-flyby: fly a lateral arc, drag Q across Zed for two seconds of burn + stacks, and land outside his answer range — repeat forever from one item.
edits.after: Death Mark makes him untargetable on the dash, so hold Falling Star and cast it where he lands, not at the Zed silhouette you can still see.

edits.before: That’s Zed’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Shadow Slash lands every 3-5s and the slow makes the next one free anyway.

edits.before: Your flight is your only escape — a W spent poking is a death sentence against the next gank.
edits.after: Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1 and it is the only thing that answers a 625 Death Mark.

edits.before: Channelling Q face-to-face inside his engage range with W down — every champion that touches you wins that exchange pre-items.
edits.after: Living Shadow means the Zed you are looking at may not be the one about to hit you — contesting a shove hands him both angles.

notes: IMPORTANT — one supplied missing-interaction is wrong and I deliberately did not write it. The brief's missingInteractions says 'Your Astral Flight (W) shuts off Zed's Living Shadow (W), Death Mark (R)'. That is generated from the ownerKit's derived terrain flag ('creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes'), but Riot's own Astral Flight text says he 'flies over terrain in a targeted direction' — he traverses terrain, he does not create it. Astral Flight does not wall off Zed's dashes, so asserting it would have shipped a false counterplay to a paying user. The kit-file note about derived flags misfiring applies exactly here. The second supplied interaction (Death Mark untargetable) is correct and is written in. Fabricated Aurelion Sol abilities 'Starsurge' and 'Voice of Light' removed, along with a 'Q stun' and 'stun uptime' his kit does not have and a 'global' ultimate that is actually 1250 range. whys[2] described Death Mark under the Level 3 row — re-pointed at Shadow Slash. Chart rows 5 and 6 moved to Aurelion Sol in the full layer to match content and the packet, phases[5].why rewritten in the same proposal. Zed is male per champ-gender; dontsFull[0].d had called him 'they'.
